title: The Hunter Captain
summary: Suffering his first crushing defeat, Ha-Jun is hidden inside an underground storm reservoir. Captain Baek's background as a deceived veteran is revealed as the Bureau hunts the city.

panels.shot: stormwater reservoir wide shot
panels.action: A vast underground subterranean water cavern with concrete columns submerged in knee-deep water.
panels.prose_en: A vast underground subterranean water cavern with concrete columns submerged in knee-deep water.
panels.prose_hi: Ghutnon tak pani mein doobi concrete ke khambhon wali ek vishal bhumigat jal gufa.

panels.shot: min-jae laying ha-jun onto wooden planks
panels.action: Min-Jae gently lowers Ha-Jun onto makeshift wooden pallets above the water, hands stained in red blood.
panels.prose_en: Min-Jae gently lowers Ha-Jun onto makeshift wooden pallets above the water, hands stained in red blood.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je dheere se ha-jun ko pani ke upar asthayi lakdi ke takhton par girata hai, uske haath lal khoon se sane hue han.

panels.shot: ha-jun broken left arm swollen and purple
panels.action: Ha-Jun's left forearm is severely deformed and swollen; white bone gauntlet fragments lie cracked on the pallet.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's left forearm is severely deformed and swollen; white bone gauntlet fragments lie cracked on the pallet.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ka bayan agrabhag gambhir roop se vikrit aur sooja hua hai; safed haddi ke gauntlet ke tukde foos par toote hue pade han.

panels.shot: ha-jun coughing hoarsely, shivering
panels.action: Ha-Jun shivers violently from shock, cold sweat and rainwater streaming down his pale, bruised face.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main haar gaya... Main itna kamzor hoon ki Jin-Woo ke ek teer ne mujhe tod diya.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun shivers violently from shock, cold sweat and rainwater streaming down his pale, bruised face.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun sadme, thande pasine aur uske pile, chotil chehre se bahte baarish ke pani se buri tarah kamp raha hai.

panels.shot: min-jae applying bone splint and bandages
panels.action: Min-Jae binds two wooden splints around Ha-Jun's broken arm, tying them tight with medical wraps.

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Dard saho, Ha-Jun... Haddiyan set kar raha hoon. Tumhara healing factor ise jod dega.

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae binds two wooden splints around Ha-Jun's broken arm, tying them tight with medical wraps.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ne ha-jun ki tuti baanh ke charon or lakdi ki do khpacchiyan baandh deen, aur unhen medical rap se kaskar baandh diya.

panels.shot: ha-jun gritting teeth in silent agony
panels.action: Ha-Jun bites into a leather strap to avoid crying out, tears of physical and emotional pain in his eyes.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun bites into a leather strap to avoid crying out, tears of physical and emotional pain in his eyes.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne rone se bachne ke liye chamde ka patta kaat liya, uski aankhon mein sharirik aur bhavnatmak dard ke aansu the.

panels.shot: kuro landing on water pipe with singed feathers
panels.action: Kuro cleans his singed obsidian wing feathers, looking down with uncharacteristically quiet eyes.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Captain Baek ordinary fighter nahi hai. Woh pichle 20 saalon se S-Rank hunter raha hai.

panels.prose_en: Kuro cleans his singed obsidian wing feathers, looking down with uncharacteristically quiet eyes.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro aswabhavik roop se shant aankhon se neeche dekhte hue, apne jhulse hue obsidian pankhon ko saaf karta hai.

panels.shot: flashback to captain baek past
panels.action: A visual vignette of a young Captain Baek 15 years ago, carrying his fallen comrades out of a demonic gate.

dialogue.text: Captain Baek ne apni puri squad ko ek Abyssal Gate raid mein khoya tha. Tab se woh Demons se nafrat karta hai.

panels.prose_en: A visual vignette of a young Captain Baek 15 years ago, carrying his fallen comrades out of a demonic gate.
panels.prose_hi: 15 saal pehle ek yuva captain bak ka ek drishya drishya, jo apne gire hue sathiyon ko ek rakshasi dwar se bahar le ja raha tha.

panels.shot: baek accepting cybernetic implants from director kang
panels.action: Director Kang offering Baek the Eclipse Greatsword and artificial heart implant in a high-tech lab.
panels.prose_en: Director Kang offering Baek the Eclipse Greatsword and artificial heart implant in a high-tech lab.
panels.prose_hi: Nideshak kang ek high-tek lab mein bake ko aclips gratusward aur kritrim hriday pratyaropan ki peshkash kar rahe han.

panels.shot: ha-jun listening through ragged breaths
panels.action: Ha-Jun listens to Kuro's tale, his clenched fist trembling: 'Toh woh evil nahi hai... Woh bas misguided hai.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Woh samajhta hai ki mujhe maar kar woh logon ko bacha raha hai...

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun listens to Kuro's tale, his clenched fist trembling: 'Toh woh evil nahi hai... Woh bas misguided hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun kuro ki kahani sunta hai, uski band mutthi kamp rahi hai: 'to wah burai nahin hai... wah bus gumrah hai.'

panels.shot: kuro snapping beak sharply
panels.action: Kuro snaps: 'Misguided ya evil, uski talwar tumhara gala kaatne ke liye ready hai!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Jung mein intention ka koi medal nahi milta! Jeet ya haar hi sabkuch hai!

panels.prose_en: Kuro snaps: 'Misguided ya evil, uski talwar tumhara gala kaatne ke liye ready hai!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne kaha: 'gumrah ho ya dusht, uski talwar tumhara gala kaatne ke liye taiyar hai!'.

panels.shot: ring of hollow blood emitting faint pulse
panels.action: The obsidian ring on Ha-Jun's finger begins pulsing with a warm, steady crimson heartbeat.
panels.prose_en: The obsidian ring on Ha-Jun's finger begins pulsing with a warm, steady crimson heartbeat.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki ungli par obsidian ring garm, sthir lal dil ki dhadkan ke saath spandit hone lagti hai.

panels.shot: bone of the forgotten knitting together internally
panels.action: Beneath his skin, calcium threads and ivory bone marrow weave back together like interlocking stitches.

dialogue.text:
[PASSIVE REGENERATION ACTIVE]
Bone of the Forgotten: Structural repair in progress.
Estimated time to full union: 6 Hours.

panels.prose_en: Beneath his skin, calcium threads and ivory bone marrow weave back together like interlocking stitches.
panels.prose_hi: Uski tvacha ke niche, calcium ke dhaage aur hathi daant ki asthi majja interlocking tanke ki tarah wapas ek saath bunte han.

panels.shot: ha-jun staring at his broken arm
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks at the glowing splint: 'Six hours... Mere paas waqt hai.'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun looks at the glowing splint: 'Six hours... Mere paas waqt hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun chamakti hui patti ko dekhta hai: 'chhah ghante... mere paas waqt hai.'

panels.shot: min-jae opening encrypted news feed
panels.action: Min-Jae turns his laptop toward Ha-Jun: 'News dekho... Bureau ne poore city mein curfew laga diya hai.'

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Unhone media ko bola hai ki ek 'Dangerous Demonic Terrorist' ghoom raha hai.

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae turns his laptop toward Ha-Jun: 'News dekho... Bureau ne poore city mein curfew laga diya hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je apna laptop ha-jun ki or ghumata hai: 'news dekho... bureau ne poore shahar mein curfew laga diya hai.'

panels.shot: news broadcast showing ha-jun blurred photo
panels.action: Korean news anchor broadcasting Ha-Jun's student photograph with a bold red 'WANTED: DEAD OR ALIVE' banner.
panels.prose_en: Korean news anchor broadcasting Ha-Jun's student photograph with a bold red 'WANTED: DEAD OR ALIVE' banner.
panels.prose_hi: Korean samachar anchor ha-jun ki chhatra tasveer ko gahre lal rang ke 'vanted: dead or alive' banner ke saath prasarit kar raha hai.

panels.shot: bureau checkposts across seoul bridges
panels.action: Armed Bureau checkpoints blocking Mapo, Hannam, and Banpo bridges with armored personnel carriers.
panels.prose_en: Armed Bureau checkpoints blocking Mapo, Hannam, and Banpo bridges with armored personnel carriers.
panels.prose_hi: Sashastra bureau chaukiyan bakhtarband karmiyon ke vahak ke saath mapo, hannam aur banpo pulon ko avruddh kar rahi han.

panels.shot: citizens being scanned with mana scanners
panels.action: Terrified citizens in raincoats forced to press palms against bio-scanners; blue laser grids scanning eyes.
panels.prose_en: Terrified citizens in raincoats forced to press palms against bio-scanners; blue laser grids scanning eyes.
panels.prose_hi: Renkot pahane bhaybhit nagrik bio-scanner par hatheliyan dabane ko majboor; aankhon ko scan karne wali neeli laser grid.

panels.shot: ha-jun eyes narrowing in cold disgust
panels.action: Ha-Jun's dual eyes ignite: 'Woh innocent logon ko harass kar rahe hain sirf mujhe dhoondhne ke liye.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main unhe meri wajah se city ko jail banane nahi doonga.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's dual eyes ignite: 'Woh innocent logon ko harass kar rahe hain sirf mujhe dhoondhne ke liye.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki dohri aankhen jalti han: 'vo nirdosh logon ko pareshan kar rahe hain sirf mujhe dhundhne ke liye.'

panels.shot: kuro hopping onto ha-jun chest
panels.action: Kuro looks deep into Ha-Jun's eyes: 'Toh kya karne ka irada hai, Sovereign Heir?'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Apni tooti hui haddiyon ke saath unke 500 hunters se ladoge?

panels.prose_en: Kuro looks deep into Ha-Jun's eyes: 'Toh kya karne ka irada hai, Sovereign Heir?'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ha-jun ki aankhon mein gahrai se dekhta hai: 'toh kya karne ka irada hai, samprabhu uttradhikari?'.

panels.shot: ha-jun pushing himself upright on one arm
panels.action: Despite the searing pain in his splinted arm, Ha-Jun forces himself to sit upright with unbending posture.
panels.prose_en: Despite the searing pain in his splinted arm, Ha-Jun forces himself to sit upright with unbending posture.
panels.prose_hi: Apni tuti hui baanh mein tej dard ke bavjud, ha-jun khud ko bina jhuke sidhe baithne ke liye majboor karta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking at kuro with absolute fire
panels.action: Ha-Jun's voice is steady as granite: 'Mujhe train karo, Kuro.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Mujhe sikhao ki First Sovereign bina kisi hesitation ke kaise ladta tha.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's voice is steady as granite: 'Mujhe train karo, Kuro.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki awaaz granite ki tarah sthir hai: 'mujhe train karo, kuro.'

panels.shot: kuro eyes widening in dark satisfaction
panels.action: Kuro's beak curls into a wicked demonic grin, his wings flaring with violet sparks.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Heh... Hahahahaha! Yahi words sunne ka intezaar tha mujhe!

panels.prose_en: Kuro's beak curls into a wicked demonic grin, his wings flaring with violet sparks.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ki chonch ek dusht rakshasi muskurahat mein badal jaati hai, uske pankh baingani chingari se chamakte han.

panels.shot: kuro explaining the essence of sovereign combat
panels.action: Kuro explains: 'Sovereign ka style brute force nahi hai. Yeh 'Blood Weaving' hai.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Khoon tumhare dushman ke har strike ko pehle se predict kar sakta hai agar tum use listen karo.

panels.prose_en: Kuro explains: 'Sovereign ka style brute force nahi hai. Yeh 'Blood Weaving' hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro batate han: 'soweren ka style pashvik bal nahin hai. yeh 'blad viving' hai.'

panels.shot: min-jae handing ha-jun a bottle of water
panels.action: Min-Jae hands him a clean water bottle: 'Main tumhare saath hoon, Ha-Jun. Jo bhi chahiye batao.'

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Maine Bureau ke server se unke communication channels hijack kar liye hain. Har move humein pehle pata chalegi.

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae hands him a clean water bottle: 'Main tumhare saath hoon, Ha-Jun. Jo bhi chahiye batao.'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ne use ek saaf pani ki botal di: 'main tumhare saath hun, ha-jun. jo bhi chahiye batao.'

panels.shot: ha-jun drinking deeply
panels.action: Ha-Jun drinks the entire bottle in three gulps, wiping his mouth with the back of his hand.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun drinks the entire bottle in three gulps, wiping his mouth with the back of his hand.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apne haath ke pichle hisse se apna muh ponchte hue puri botal teen ghunt mein pee jata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun standing on feet in water
panels.action: Ha-Jun steps off the pallet into the cold knee-deep water, grounding his balance.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun steps off the pallet into the cold knee-deep water, grounding his balance.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun foos se nikalkar ghutnon tak thande pani mein chala jata hai, jisse uska santulan bigad jata hai.

panels.shot: violet flame igniting around his splinted arm
panels.action: Gentle violet hellfire wraps around the splinted bone, acting as an external exoskeleton cast.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Flame of the Fallen meri tooti haddi ko bahar se lock kar sakti hai!

panels.prose_en: Gentle violet hellfire wraps around the splinted bone, acting as an external exoskeleton cast.
panels.prose_hi: Komal baingani narkankaal vibhajit haddi ke charon or lapetata hai, bahari exoscalaton cast ke roop mein karya karta hai.

panels.shot: kuro diving into combat stance
panels.action: Kuro hovers in midair, conjuring ten sharp obsidian feather daggers around his body.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Pehla lesson: In daggers ko blindfold hokar dodge karo!

panels.prose_en: Kuro hovers in midair, conjuring ten sharp obsidian feather daggers around his body.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro hawa mein mandrata hai, apne shareer ke charon or das tej obsidian pankh wale khanjar ghumata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun closing his eyes in the water
panels.action: Ha-Jun ties a dark strip of cloth over his eyes, opening his senses to the ripples in the water: 'Ready.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Aao, Kuro. Mujhe tod kar naya banao.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun ties a dark strip of cloth over his eyes, opening his senses to the ripples in the water: 'Ready.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apni aankhon par kapde ki ek kali patti bandhta hai, jisse pani mein laharon ke prati uski indriyan khul jaati han: 'taiyar.'
